module: Flowgraph node "Logbook Entry" (category once_instant, career color/icon). Adds an entry to the career logbook (career_modules_logbook.genericInfoUnlocked) with a title and a text. Inputs: title, text (string). Does nothing outside career. Copies the input flow to the output.

workOnce.desc: If career is active and the logbook module is present, adds the entry; copies flow to the output.
